- name: "5.13 | PATCH | Ensure 'Peer Name Resolution Protocol (PNRPsvc)' is set to 'Disabled'"
  when: win11cis_rule_5_13
  tags:
    - level2-high-security-sensitive-data-environment
    - patch
    - automated
    - rule_5.13
    - pnrpsvc
  block:
    - name: "5.13 | AUDIT | Ensure 'Peer Name Resolution Protocol (PNRPsvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Check to see if pnrpsvc service exists"
      ansible.windows.win_service_info:
        name: PNRPsvc
      register: discovered_5_13_pnrpsvc_service_info

    - name: "5.13 | PATCH | Ensure 'Peer Name Resolution Protocol (PNRPsvc)' is set to 'Disabled' | Disable pnrpsvc service"
      when: discovered_5_13_pnrpsvc_service_info.exists
      ansible.windows.win_service:
        name: PNRPsvc
        start_mode: disabled
        state: stopped
